shared_elements: T-shaped monolithic pillar as the carved field
quadruped animal in profile in low relief
animals rendered in shallow relief on a vertical shaft
elongated snake-like/limbed forms below the main animal
stacked/register-like placement of motifs down the shaft
relief motifs on the horizontal pillar head
justification: Both surfaces are anthropomorphic T-shaped pillars bearing shallow, flatly-modelled relief animals in strict profile, with a prominent quadruped on the shaft and further elongated, snake-like or limbed forms beneath it, a distinctive and non-generic combination of carrier and imagery. The main difference is density and content: B carries a crowded multi-register programme (row of creatures and a hatched band across the head, birds and a large long-necked bird on the shaft), whereas A shows only a single quadruped with a few sparse linear forms below, and B lacks A's isolated, uncluttered composition.
